data.gender_notes: Chakor is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chakor is a name derived from Persian, referring to a type of lovely bird known for its beautiful songs and vibrant plumage. It symbolizes freedom and joy. The name Chakor carries the meaning “Lovely Bird” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chakor usually hope their child will grow to embody lovely bird and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Chakor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lovely Bird.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chakor total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
